# dotnet-inspect

A CLI tool for inspecting .NET assemblies and NuGet packages. Useful for understanding package contents, comparing API surfaces between versions, and auditing assemblies for SourceLink/determinism.

## Commands

### package - Inspect NuGet packages

```bash
# View package metadata
dotnet-inspect package Newtonsoft.Json

# List DLLs (tools/ for tool packages, lib/ for regular packages)
dotnet-inspect package Newtonsoft.Json --files

# List all files in package
dotnet-inspect package Newtonsoft.Json --files --all

# List available versions (stable only)
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json --versions

# Include prereleases
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json --versions --preview

# Limit results
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json --versions -n 5
```

### assembly - Inspect .NET assemblies

```bash
# Basic assembly info
dotnet-inspect assembly MyLib.dll

# Audit for SourceLink and determinism
dotnet-inspect assembly MyLib.dll --audit

# From a NuGet package (latest version)
dotnet-inspect assembly lib/net8.0/Foo.dll --package Newtonsoft.Json

# From a specific package version
dotnet-inspect assembly lib/net9.0/System.Text.Json.dll --package System.Text.Json@9.0.2
```

### api - View public API surface

```bash
# List all types in a local assembly
dotnet-inspect api --assembly MyLib.dll

# List all types from a specific assembly in a package
dotnet-inspect api --package System.Text.Json --assembly lib/net10.0/System.Text.Json.dll

# View a specific type's API (searches all assemblies in package)
dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json

# From a specific version
dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json@9.0.2

# Filter to specific member(s) - shows all overloads with full signatures
dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json -m Deserialize

# Multiple members
dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json -m Serialize -m Deserialize

# SourceLink URL and/or docs (requires embedded PDB with SourceLink)
dotnet-inspect api AnsiConsole --package Spectre.Console --source-url --docs

# Docs for specific member
dotnet-inspect api Renderable --package Spectre.Console --docs -m Render

# JSON output
dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json --json

# Compact JSON (minified, omits false/default values)
dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json --json --compact

# Limit members in output (works with both markdown and JSON)
dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json -n 5

# Quiet mode with member filter (compact signature list)
dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json -m Deserialize -v:q
```

## Common Workflows

```bash
# Compare API between versions
diff <(dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json@9.0.2) \
     <(dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json@10.0.2)

# Compare specific method overloads between versions
diff <(dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json@9.0.2 -m Deserialize) \
     <(dotnet-inspect api JsonSerializer --package System.Text.Json@10.0.2 -m Deserialize)

# Find assemblies in a package
dotnet-inspect package Newtonsoft.Json --files

# Check SourceLink/determinism
dotnet-inspect assembly MyLib.dll --audit

# Get package dependencies
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json --deps

# Find latest stable version
dotnet-inspect package System.Text.Json --versions -n 1
```

## Output Formats

- Default: Markdown tables (good for terminal display)
- `--json`: JSON output (good for programmatic parsing)
- `--json --compact`: Minified JSON, omits false/default values
- `--markout`: Explicit markdown output (default)

## Verbosity Levels

Control section detail with `-v:` option:

- `-v:q` - Quiet: summary only
- `-v:m` - Minimal: summary + compact metadata
- `-v:n` - Normal: full sections (default)
- `-v:d` - Detailed: all sections with full tables

## Section Filtering (H2s)

Filter output by H2 section numbers (first H2 = 1, etc.). Content before first H2 is always included.

**Section indices by command:**
- `package`: 1=Metadata, 2=Package Dependencies
- `assembly`: 1=Assembly Info, 2=Build Audit (with --audit)
- `api` (type list): 1=Types
- `api` (single type): 1=Members

```bash
dotnet-inspect package Foo -s:1      # Metadata only
dotnet-inspect package Foo -x:2      # Exclude dependencies
dotnet-inspect package Foo -v:d -s:1 # Detailed metadata only
```

## Tips

- Package names support version suffix: `PackageName@1.2.3`
- Assembly paths in packages use forward slashes: `lib/net8.0/Foo.dll`
- `-m`/`--member` filter is case-insensitive, shows all matching overloads; use with `-v:q` for compact list
- `--source-url` and `--docs` require embedded PDB with SourceLink (Spectre.Console has it, System.Text.Json does not)
- Use `--verbose` to see progress messages on stderr
